titles.title: A King Is Born on the Road

description:
Iris Repos. She was the queen of a fallen kingdom. While even the king had fled, she remained alone on the throne, refusing to abandon her place. It was then that Heier, her husband's younger brother and her first love, came to find her.     

"Your Majesty, can you find the North Gate as well?"     

Born with a map of the entire world etched into her mind, Iris Repos was said to be capable of finding her way even in the middle of a desert. Iris nodded. And the moment she passed through the North Gate after enduring a relentless snowstorm, she realized something extraordinary. She had traveled six years back in time.     

"If something changes after we cross the North Gate, then please don't fall in love with me."    

She also realized that she had been given the chance to save the man who had died for her sake. A second chance granted by a miracle. Will Iris be able to save the man she loves and walk the path of a king?
